overview: Telecom Customer Churn Prevention addresses operational records arrive through different systems, supervisors reconstruct evidence manually, and decisions are difficult to audit in telecommunications operations. The first proof of value uses recharge histories, plan usage and customer complaints. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is retained customers in controlled cohort, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: recharge histories, plan usage and customer complaints; define retained customers in controlled cohort and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Network Operations Director / Telco Product VP.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including line-by-line reconciliations against known business transactions.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
